pick.name: GitHub Actions
pick.why: Free unlimited minutes on public repos (open-core) + 2,000/mo private; biggest action ecosystem; Claude Code writes it fluently
pick.free_limits: Free plan: 2,000 min/mo private, 500 MB artifacts, 10 GB cache/repo; public repos and self-hosted runners free; Linux 2-core $0.006/min; planned $0.002/min self-hosted fee was postponed (Dec 2025); Copilot code review consumes minutes

alts.name: Self-hosted runner on Oracle VM
alts.what: Run Actions jobs on your free VM
alts.free_limits: No GitHub charge for self-hosted runners (fee postponed)

candidates.verdict: Alt: simplest for pure Workers apps

candidates.name: Self-hosted runner
candidates.verdict: Alt: when private minutes run out

candidates.name: GitLab CI
candidates.verdict: Fine but you live on GitHub

decision: GitHub Actions is the default; keep core repos public to make CI free. Add a self-hosted runner on the Oracle VM only if private-repo minutes run out.
details: Pin third-party actions to commit SHAs (see Trivy incident in security slot).

verify.note: GitHub doc: Free = 2,000 min private, 500 MB artifacts, 10 GB cache/repo; free for public repos + self-hosted; Linux 2-core $0.006/min; Copilot code review consumes Actions minutes. The doc does not mention the postponed $0.002/min self-hosted fee (it only says self-hosted is free), which is consistent with 'postponed'. Workers Builds 3,000 min/1 concurrent/20 min confirmed.
